mapper.sql: e.owner_id,e.id,e.relation_id,e.source_id,e.target_id,e.relation_type AS type,e.reason, e.task_id,e.attempt_id,e.feedback_id,e.report_hash,e.source_count,e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id, e.decision_revision,e.decision_choice,e.created_at, d.revision AS actual_decision_revision,d.choice AS actual_decision_choice
FROM knowledge_relation_ai_feedback_evidence e LEFT JOIN ai_feedback_decision d ON d.owner_id=e.owner_id AND d.task_id=e.task_id AND d.feedback_id=e.feedback_id AND d.revision=e.decision_revision
mapper.select: SELECT r.owner_id,r.id,r.source_id,r.target_id,r.relation_type AS type, s.kind AS source_kind,s.status AS source_status,t.kind AS target_kind,t.status AS target_status FROM knowledge_relation r JOIN knowledge_item s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.source_id JOIN knowledge_item t ON t.owner_id=r.owner_id AND t.id=r.target_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_ai_feedback_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND relation_id=#{relationId})
SELECT owner_id,id,snapshot_json FROM knowledge_relation_ai_feedback_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
